# Hedgy's Swordtember (sword icons)

Six packs of thirty 32x32 pixel-art swords, one per year of Swordtember, by **TheWiseHedgehog** ("Hedgy"):
https://thewisehedgehog.itch.io/hs2020 (and hs2021 ... hs2025).

Licence: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The pack pages say: "You're free to use it commercially, consider crediting me and leaving a feedback." CC BY requires credit,
so every game that shows these swords must name the author, e.g. in its credits: "Swords: Hedgy's Swordtember by TheWiseHedgehog (CC BY 4.0)".

How we know (2026-11-14): the owner downloaded the six sheets and sent screenshots of two pack pages with the licence text
(`art/incoming/swords/raw/licence_page_a.png`, `licence_page_b.png`) and said the other pages read the same ("ก็เหมือนกันแหละ").
The author's name comes from a web search (the pages could not be opened from the cloud session); the owner's screenshots do not show it.
Which sheet is which year was not told: `sheet1` ... `sheet6` are in the order the owner sent them.
Raw files unchanged in `art/incoming/swords/raw/`; packed for the games by `tools/art/sword_pack.py` into `art/swords/` (pictures not altered).
